summary: Frontend testing of two new features on Samarth Patel portfolio: (1) light/dark theme toggle and (2) resume preview modal. Verified theme toggle in navbar and mobile menu (data-testid nav-theme-toggle & mobile-theme-toggle) — starts in dark, clicking switches html.dark class off, sets document.style.colorScheme=light, persists 'light' to localStorage['samarth-portfolio-theme']. Icons swap (Moon in dark, Sun in light) via aria-label check + svg class 'lucide-sun'. Reload persists theme (no FOUC — pre-hydration script works). Verified resume preview dialog opens (does NOT navigate to new tab) from hero-resume-button, nav-resume-button, and mobile-resume-button. Dialog contains title 'Resume — Samarth Patel', 'Open in new tab' link (target=_blank + rel=noopener noreferrer + href=/resume.pdf), 'Download' link (download attr + href=/resume.pdf). HEAD fetch to /resume.pdf returns 404, so the empty-state renders with FileText icon and text 'Resume preview isn't available yet. Drop a resume.pdf file into the public/ folder...' — NO broken 'This page could not be found' iframe visible. Dialog closes on Escape and on the shadcn X close button. Existing features (Hero, projects (18 project-* testids), contact form, availability badge, navbar) remain intact in both themes. Light-mode body bg=rgb(255,255,255), headline color=rgb(24,24,27) — good contrast. 45/45 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeProvider hydrates from localStorage in a useEffect AFTER first render (setThemeState(readStoredTheme(...))). If localStorage has 'light' but the React state initially defaults to 'dark', the second useEffect (DOM sync) will briefly toggle .dark on then off. In practice this is masked by the inline themeInitScript which sets .dark on <html> before hydration, so users see no flash — but the very first useEffect run after mount will set .dark back on for a tick if defaultTheme='dark' and stored='light'. Consider using a lazy initializer: useState(() => readStoredTheme(defaultTheme)) inside a 'use client' component to reduce redundant DOM writes. Non-blocking.

ResumeDialog does a HEAD fetch every time the dialog opens (useEffect on open). If the PDF ever becomes available, this is fine; while it's absent, a request is fired each time. Could cache the availability result. Non-blocking.
resume-preview-iframe data-testid is on the <object> element which never actually renders when failed=true, so tests should not depend on it in the empty state (they don't, so fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio at https://samarth-portfolio-1.preview.emergentagent.com/. Theme toggle localStorage key: 'samarth-portfolio-theme' (values: 'light'|'dark'). Testids: nav-theme-toggle, mobile-theme-toggle, hero-resume-button, nav-resume-button, mobile-resume-button, resume-preview-dialog, resume-open-tab-link, resume-download-link, resume-preview-iframe (only when PDF exists). The Sun/Moon icon can be detected via svg class 'lucide-sun'/'lucide-moon' or aria-label of the button. Resume PDF at /resume.pdf intentionally returns 404 — dialog shows empty state (text 'Resume preview isn't available yet.'). Contact form still uses mailto fallback. Dark mode is default; both themes render existing sections correctly (18 project-* testids present). Playwright evaluate/attribute calls MUST be awaited in this env.
